hints.intent: The sign above the enemy shows its next move and how hard it will hit.
hints.energy: Each card costs energy, shown in its corner. Your energy refills every turn; what you don't use is lost.
hints.block: Block soaks up damage until your next turn. Play Defend when the enemy is about to attack.
hints.endTurn: Out of energy? Press End turn. The enemy makes its move, then you draw a new hand.
